rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a snowstorm, especially when strong winds are part of the picture.

example.english: The snowstorm last night made going out really difficult.
example.traditional: 噚晚落大風雪，出街真係好辛苦。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 lok6 daai6 fung1 syut3 ceot1 gaai1 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when you mean a heavy snowfall rather than a wind-driven blizzard.

example.english: The snowstorm brought heavy snow, so school is closed today.
example.traditional: 今日落大雪，學校停課喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 syut3 hok6 haau6 ting4 fo3 laa3
